Talent3_5Ability.name: Initiative
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When attacked, trigger <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf> before the enemy, then trigger <buf ID=900028>[Add Strike]</buf> after the enemy's attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.75x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.
Allows a Light Rifle to attack targets within an adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) area.

600001.name: Entrenched 1
600001.SpecificEffects: Trigger <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> to protect adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) allies from Assault and Ranged attacks, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

600402.name: Broken Arm
600402.describe: Uses Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25x</color> DMG. This attack prioritizes Arms.

700045.name: Militant
700045.SpecificEffects: When taking damage, gain <buf ID=7000452>[Fury]</buf> after combat, up to <color=#F74848>4</color> stacks, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

600404.name: Aggressive
600404.describe: Protects adjacent allies (<color=#F74848>2</color> tiles) from Assault and Ranged attacks, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Gains <buf ID=6004041>[Aggressive]</buf> for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

700040.name: Multiple-refined
700040.SpecificEffects: For every <color=#F74848>10%</color> reduction in self HP, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

600406.name: Sudden Shot
600406.describe: Uses Light Rifle to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> DMG. Triggers <buf ID=900001>[Flurry Strike]</buf> after the enemy attacks, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> DMG. Before combat, gains <buf ID=7100105>[Hit Rate Up III]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

600407.name: Rifle Mastery
600407.SpecificEffects: If no part is broken after attacking, DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-15%</color>.

600408.name: Sensor Jamming
600408.describe: Uses Light Rifle to shoot a target <color=#F74848>2</color> times, each shot dealing <color=#F74848>1x</color> DMG. After combat, it inflicts <buf ID=6004081>[Reaction Hysteresis]</buf> on the target, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

600022.name: Armor Specialization 2
600022.SpecificEffects: When performing <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf>, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

600031.name: Indestructible 1
600031.SpecificEffects: When the Arm suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking to <color=#F74848>1</color> HP, effective <color=#F74848>1</color> time per battle.

600033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
600033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

600034.name: Indestructible 2
600034.SpecificEffects: The part that triggers <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf> restores <color=#F74848>35%</color> of its HP after combat.

600035.name: Indestructible 3
600035.SpecificEffects: Make <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf> able to trigger again after <color=#F74848>3</color> turns, with no effective time limit for each battle.

600036.name: Indestructible 4
600036.SpecificEffects: When any part suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>.

600441.name: Northern Spirit 1
600441.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf> or <buf ID=900028>[Add Strike]</buf>, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

600043.name: Entrenched 4
600043.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can now be triggered an unlimited number of times per turn.

600445.name: Northern Spirit 3
600445.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf>, prioritize hitting the Arm part.

600446.name: Northern Spirit 4
600446.SpecificEffects: When triggering <buf ID=900028>[Add Strike]</buf>, prioritize hitting the part with the lowest HP.
